info.title: Autours API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for Autours car rental platform. Covers all JSON endpoints needed to build a separated frontend.

**Auth modes:**
- Session cookie auth for web routes (login via `/login` sets session cookie)
- Bearer token (Sanctum) for API routes (login via `/api/external/supplier/login`)
- Some routes use middleware guards: `admin`, `admin_or_supplier`, `active_supplier`, `customer`, `member`
